downloads.product: NASA PDS LRO-L-LROC-5-RDR-V1.0, volume LROLRC_2001, WAC_HAPKEPARAMMAP_643NM v1.1 (created 2020-07-24): 9-band Hapke parameter map, 1 deg x 1 deg, 70N-70S
downloads.citation: Sato, H., Robinson, M. S., Hapke, B., Denevi, B. W., Boyd, A. K. (2014) Resolved Hapke parameter maps of the Moon. J. Geophys. Res. Planets 119, 1775-1805, doi:10.1002/2013JE004580
downloads.decode_note: PDS3 attached label is 4 x 1440-byte records; the image starts at byte 5760 (the PDS4 .xml gives 1440, which does not fit the file size). 9 bands x 140 lines x 360 samples, float32 LSB, band-sequential.
downloads.used_as: medians compiled into blender/v2/hapke.py PARAMS_643NM (recomputed by blender/tests/test_hapke.py when cached)
fixed parameters: Bc0 = 0.0, hc = 1.0, theta = 23.657 deg, phi (filling factor) 'fixed at 1.0' (stored as 0.0 in the image; porosity factor K = 1)

downloads.product: NASA SVS 4851 Deep Star Maps 2020, 4096 x 2048 plate carree, ICRF/J2000, half-float linear EXR (Hipparcos-2, Tycho-2, Gaia DR2)
downloads.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio. Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC
downloads.note: Smallest full star map on the page that is in equatorial coordinates. Display-scaled: bright stars clip at 1.0 and the page gives no flux units, so brightness in the scene is VISUAL. Layout: RA 0 at the centre increasing to the left (verified by blender/tests/star_check.py).
